positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Aided in the development of a customer support platform for Google Shopping, enabling real-time communications between support operators, support leads, and customers.

Work aimed to introduce features that reduce the average handle time of customer tickets, while remaining SOP compliant.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a model to perform infant finger print recognition based around the idea of Siamese Networks. The idea was formed as an approach to overcome complications of traditional fingerprinting procedures. After K-fold cross-validation, accuracy was shown to peak at around 85%.

Worked on building models for detecting children with FASD, using data points given by groups of participating hospitals in a project funded by the Gates Foundation.

company.name: Qualcomm Institute - UC San Diego Division of Calit2

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Implemented an administrative interface to easily manage the Riot Games Store product catalog.

Designed the store’s architecture for managing and serving product images. Used a combination of ElasticSearch, S3 File Storage, and CloudFront to handle weekly loads of 20,000+ visitors across 8+ regions.

positions.title: CSE 21, Algorithms Tutor
positions.description: Helped students understand graph theory, combinatorics, encoding/decoding, and general algorithms.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked with Hadoop, Pig, Hive, and Spark, to perform parallel computation on millions of user profiles for the purposes of data analytics. 

Developed a micro-service in Java Spring Boot that served the results of the data analysis via REST API.
